column1: # Module attribution artefacts -- read by AttributionTest.
# SCOPE         <TAB> subtree (under src/main/java) the manifest must cover COMPLETELY.
#                     Omitted = the whole module. The directory must exist.
# FILE          <TAB> path relative to the module directory [<TAB> in-jar copy]
# LICENSETUPLE  <TAB> groupId <TAB> artifactId <TAB> version <TAB> name <TAB> url
# SHA256        <TAB> path relative to the module directory <TAB> lower-case hex digest
# A LICENSE-*.txt FILE row additionally requires a byte-identical copy at
# src/main/resources/META-INF/<same name>, so the text the notices point at is the one that
# actually ships inside the jar. A FILE row with a third column names that in-jar copy
# explicitly (relative to src/main/resources) and is held to the same byte-identity: this repo's
# licence is the conventional root LICENSE, shipped as META-INF/LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt -- the
# name the data browser's jar used for the same text before these files moved here.
# No SCOPE row: the WHOLE module is in scope. Every file this repo ever adds needs a manifest
# row -- NOT_DERIVED for P300's own, which is still a classification somebody had to make.
FILE
FILE
FILE
# The verbatim LGPL-2.1 text (owner, 2026-09-24): the byte-identity rule above only proves the
# jar copy equals LICENSE, not that LICENSE is still the LGPL-2.1.
SHA256
LICENSETUPLE
